psychological_meaning: Nepal, a muted blue-gray, evokes feelings of tranquility and stability. It suggests reliability and dependability, similar to the steadfastness of the Himalayan mountains. This color encourages introspection and can foster a sense of calm and collectedness, promoting mental clarity and a peaceful atmosphere.
